The task: write UI strings in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) for a computer peripherals settings page: adjusting pointer device movement speed, and display device brightness.

- s1: label for pointer device speed → 「滑鼠速度」or「指標速度」. The instruction says 指標裝置 (pointer device). In Taiwan Windows settings, it's "滑鼠" for mouse, but "指標" for pointer. The screen description says "調整指標裝置的移動速度" — pointer device movement speed. Label could be "指標速度" or "滑鼠速度". Since it says 指標裝置, "指標速度" is appropriate. Taiwan Windows uses "滑鼠速度" or "指標速度". Actually Windows Taiwan: "滑鼠" settings with "指標速度". Given the description says 指標裝置, I'll use "指標速度" or "指標移動速度". A label should be concise: "指標速度".

- s2: display brightness label → "螢幕亮度" (not 屏幕). Taiwan uses 螢幕. Could be "顯示器亮度" but 螢幕亮度 is common. Display device = 顯示裝置/顯示器. "螢幕亮度" is natural.

- s3: page title → "周邊設定" or "電腦周邊設定". The page adjusts pointer speed and brightness, so title could be "裝置設定" or "周邊裝置設定". The screen is 電腦周邊設定頁. Title: "周邊裝置設定" or "電腦周邊設定". I'll use "周邊裝置設定" or simply "裝置設定". Hmm, periphery settings page title — I'll go with "周邊裝置設定".

Avoid mainland terms. All good: 指標速度, 螢幕亮度, 周邊裝置設定.

Output JSON only.</think>{"s1": "指標速度", "s2": "螢幕亮度", "s3": "周邊裝置設定"}
